question: In The Delian Tomb adventure, what happens if a character tries to open one of the sarcophagi or take items from the treasure room?
expected_answer: Three skeletons emerge from random sarcophagi and attack the party.

bm25_simple.answer: Three skeletons emerge from random sarcophagi and attack. Trigger: opening sarcophagi OR taking items (non-sword) OR non-oath character taking sword. Oath-sworn characters recognize holy place. Treasure: 3d20 gp per sarcophagus, gold circlets (30 gp each), tapestry (45 gp). Source: The Delian Tomb p.7-8.

quality.notes: Complete answer in single query. Core trigger, oath context, and treasure values all found.

bm25_2round.answer: Three skeletons emerge from random sarcophagi. Two triggers: (1) non-oath character takes sword, (2) any character opens sarcophagi or takes other items. Edict Blade (+1 longsword, +2 vs goblinoids). Treasure: 3d20 gp per sarcophagus, circlets 30 gp, tapestry 45 gp. Round 2 skipped. Source: The Delian Tomb p.7-8.

quality.notes: Comprehensive with Edict Blade stats and both trigger conditions. Round 2 not needed.
